turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Thanks for joining today. I would like you to imagine that you have just finished a research interview and need to add its transcript to your project. Please talk through what you expect to happen as you begin.

turns.speaker: Elaine Montgomery
turns.text: I would first look for the Session I just completed. From there I would expect an obvious place to upload the transcript, and I would want confirmation that I selected the right Participant before anything is processed.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: What information would help you feel confident that the upload is working?

turns.speaker: Elaine Montgomery
turns.text: A progress indicator would help, but the status language matters more. I want to know whether AIR is uploading, transcribing, or analyzing, because those are different steps and they may take different amounts of time.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Suppose the file finishes processing and AIR finds two speakers. What would you expect to do next?

turns.speaker: Elaine Montgomery
turns.text: I would expect to review the speaker names before coding. If AIR labels them as Speaker 1 and Speaker 2, I need a quick way to map those labels to the facilitator and Participant without editing every turn individually.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: Is there anything that would make you hesitate before continuing to Transcript Coding?

turns.speaker: Elaine Montgomery
turns.text: Yes. I would hesitate if I could not tell whether the original file was preserved. I would also want to know that correcting a speaker name will not change timestamps or break the connection between a Highlight and the original Transcript.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: What would a successful handoff into coding look like?

turns.speaker: Elaine Montgomery
turns.text: I would see the full Transcript, the corrected speaker names, and a clear indication that processing is complete. Then I could select a passage, create a Highlight, and apply a Code without wondering whether the content is still changing behind the scenes.

turns.speaker: Maya Chen
turns.text: That covers everything I wanted to learn. Thank you.
